LESSON: STORAGE OF CROP PRODUCE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.2: Storage of Crop Produce

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Storage of Crop Produce
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can we prepare the facility in readiness for the storage of crop produce?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain ways of preparing storage structures before storing crop produce

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Storage of Crop Produce

Teach
• Observe Storage of Crop Produce in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Storage of Crop Produce (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Storage of Crop Produce.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Storage of Crop Produce.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Storage of Crop Produce.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• explain ways of preparing storage structures before storing crop produce

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Storage of Crop Produce.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Storage of Crop Produce: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we prepare the facility in readiness for the storage of crop produce?
2. How should crop produce be managed during storage?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain ways of preparing storage structures before storing crop produce
